dialogs.text: Hehe, the wind in the forest told Aragita Nara's coming to play with Aragita.
Sure. What are we playing?
A wooden chest can store a lot of things, like... shiny of various elements! Aragita remembers <color=#00E1FFFF>where the Dendro shiny is</color>. Can Nara also remember?
No problem. Let's do this.
Not the right timing.
Aragita won't rush. Will wait for the "right timing."
Grass and trees remember, so does Nara. Nara is Aranara's friend, and the friend of grass and trees, too.
Nara got it wrong, but it doesn't matter. There is a lot of "next time". Any time playing with Nara is "the right time" for Aragita.
It's been a long wait for Aragita and the Golden Nara is finally here. Don't let this chance slip away. Let's play?
Sure. What are we playing?
Aragita hid all kinds of things under the stones that could be lifted to see if Nara has the ability of "never forget."
Not the right timing.
Aragita won't rush. Will wait for the "right timing."

Nara got it wrong, but it doesn't matter. There is a lot of "next time". Any time playing with Nara is "the right time" for Aragita.
It's Aranara's friend! Good Nara, want to play with Aragita?
Sure. What are we playing?
Under the stone that can be lifted, there are not only lizards but also other things. Nara has to remember the location of everything.
